explained.summary: Think how many things happen inside you at a single instant, in your body and your mind together. Once you see that, it’s no longer surprising that far more, indeed everything that exists, can be happening at once in the single whole we call the universe. Marcus is stretching his sense of scale to make the cosmos feel less bewildering.
